decision.title: What summaries count
decision.before: Totals and summaries include every entry, whatever its category.
decision.after: Transfers are not spending. Entries in the category `Transfer` are left out of all totals and summaries: totalsByCategory, balance, the report, and any summary such as monthly totals. (Changed 2026-10-20.)

1.1.title: Monthly summary
1.1.body: monthlyTotals(ledger) in src/summary.js returns [{ month: 'YYYY-MM', total: cents }] sorted by month, and `node src/cli.js monthly` prints one line per month, like `2026-10: 85.25`. Add tests.
criteria: monthlyTotals(ledger) returns [{ month, total }] sorted by month
`node src/cli.js monthly` prints one `YYYY-MM: amount` line per month
Totals follow decision D5 (what summaries count)

1.2.title: Report sorted by total
1.2.body: The report lists categories by total, largest first; ties are ordered by category name. Add tests.
criteria: renderReport lists categories by total, largest first
Ties are ordered by category name
